Table 5: Cross-domain accuracy stays well above chance, showing model-specific signals generalize across semantic domains. Cell (X, Y) is the accuracy of a classifier trained on domain X and evaluated on domain Y across 7 models; random chance is 100/7 ≈ 14.3%.

Table 6: Domain co-occurrence shows little correlation with classification accuracy, ruling out semantic content as the primary signal. Orig. is the prompt domain; Quest. is the domain queried in the image. Cell values are the percentage of Orig. images containing elements of Quest. (e.g., (people, animals) = 4.3%).
Figure 4: Images generated by Janus, MMaDA, and Show-o2 with prompts in English, Spanish, Japanese, Turkish, and Chinese (columns, left to right).
Figure 2: Attribution accuracy scales rapidly, surpassing 90% at 3K images/model and reaching 99.9% at 25K.
Figure 3: MLLMs plateau near 50% accuracy even with 5-shot exemplars, well below a specialized classifier.
